---
title: "WebScrapping Individual Beatles"
output: html_document
---

```{r}
library(rvest)
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)
library(readr)
library(robotstxt)

get_kworb_songs <- function(url, artist_name, file_name) {
  
  # Check robots.txt permission
  if (!paths_allowed(url)) {
    stop(paste("Scraping is not allowed by robots.txt for:", url))
  }
  
  # Read page
  page <- read_html(url)
  tables <- page |> html_table(fill = TRUE)
  
  # Extract data
  songs <- tables[[2]] |>
    select(`Song Title`, Streams, Daily) |>
    rename(
      song_title = `Song Title`,
      streams = Streams,
      daily = Daily
    ) |>
    mutate(
      artist = artist_name,
      song_title = str_remove(song_title, "^\\*\\s*"),
      streams = as.numeric(gsub(",", "", streams)),
      daily = as.numeric(gsub(",", "", daily))
    ) |>
    select(artist, song_title, streams, daily)
  
  # Save to CSV
  write_csv(songs, file_name)
  
  return(songs)
}

# Paul McCartney
paul_songs <- get_kworb_songs(
  url = "https://kworb.net/spotify/artist/4STHEaNw4mPZ2tzheohgXB_songs.html",
  artist_name = "Paul McCartney",
  file_name = "paul_mccartney_song_streams.csv"
)

# John Lennon
john_songs <- get_kworb_songs(
  url = "https://kworb.net/spotify/artist/4x1nvY2FN8jxqAFA0DA02H_songs.html",
```
